svg.title: Sound engineer — Man
svg.desc: A fictional man working as sound engineer, wearing a collared shirt. Visible work cue: Three fader channels on a mixing console sit at deliberately different levels. The person is on the right, with the work cue on the left. Appearance: side-swept hair, a tapered face.
